articles.title: Election budget increases by six percent, security takes largest share
articles.summary: Government figures from Kathmandu indicate that elections in Nepal are becoming significantly more expensive. This trend, impacting recent and upcoming House of Representatives polls, is primarily driven by rising prices. For SSB aspirants, understanding such regional electoral cost dynamics highlights economic pressures on democracies and potential governance challenges in neighboring nations like Nepal.

articles.title: Why is South Africa upset about Iran joining BRICS naval drills?
articles.summary: South Africa has launched an inquiry into Iran's participation in recent joint naval drills with BRICS nations. This investigation follows concerns that Iran's involvement occurred apparently against President Cyril Ramaphosa's orders. The incident highlights potential internal political tensions within South Africa regarding its foreign policy and military engagements, impacting its diplomatic stance within the BRICS bloc and international relations.

articles.title: ‘Our focus for next five years is to triple exports from India and our plants in Indonesia, Vietnam’: Aakash Minda
articles.summary: Minda Corporation Ltd, a major Indian auto component supplier to almost all domestic manufacturers, is strategically focused on tripling its exports within the next five years. This ambitious plan involves leveraging its manufacturing base in India and international plant locations to expand its global footprint, underscoring India's growing capabilities in the automotive sector and its push for increased global trade contributions.
